Every child is labeled critical, so every completion goes to a cold verifier; a critic is added wherever assertional tests change (all six order new behavior tests, so expect six).

FIRST CHILD CLOSED (orchestrator, 2026-09-04 07:46 EDT). ancora-41r.6 merged: fast-forward e18fa05 -> d96d42f. Verifier reproduced F8 at both ends on the epic base 7511407 (gate pass, chip pass; pre-fix derivation restored renders chip fail on the identical run) and built the error side independently; three mutations each failed one distinct assertion; the chip now comes from the same Verdict.pass? call spec.check uses. All six children implemented within twenty minutes of admission; five remain in grading. Every remaining child now needs a rebase onto d96d42f before its gate; spec files overlap (gate.spec is touched by 41r.1, .2, .3, .4), so some rebases will carry real hunks. console_triggers=3 console_redeploys=3. LESSON + ROUTE (orchestrator, 2026-09-04 07:55 EDT). Three first verifications failed and are in audit; the code held in every case, the contracts did not.
41r.2 (absent spec-meta): all three mutations behave, crash-to-finding confirmed across main, e18fa05 and HEAD, all six tasks clean; the Gap is that the `checked subjects=` line has a second emitter, Ancora.validate/2 at lib/ancora.ex:56, which still counts files, so spec.check prints 0 and spec.validate prints 1 on the same fixture while the new must sentences say "each corpus-reading Mix task". lib/ancora.ex is outside the Allowed list; the auditor decides between scoping the sentences to spec.check and a scope grant.
41r.5 (override key): everything proves both ways and the finding cannot be silenced by severities or a trailer; the Gap is that the must says "any other entry key" and both tests use only `requirement`: a parser that rejects that one literal and drops the rest silently passes all 40 tests. One fixture line.
41r.1 (git paths): two gaps and a critic FAIL. The derive sentence "callers shall tag paths and object ids" is false in the commit that ships it because BaseView (out of scope, kzw) still passes a bare OID; and behavior 1's named mutation (space-split cat-file parse) is no longer reachable from the CLI once prefetch resolves paths to OIDs, so only the unit test kills it while the contract named the CLI. Critic: PATH mutated via System.put_env in an async: true module (latent race across eight git-touching modules), and drift asserted by code membership only, never by file, in a ticket whose bug class is a path stored under the wrong name.
41r.3 critic FAIL (below-tip fold ordering undiscriminated) is with its verifier; 41r.4 critic PASS, verifier running.

LESSONS
- [stale-spec] Before writing "callers shall X" into a subject, enumerate the callers in that subject's Modules block and run one; a sentence that is false at the commit that ships it is the exact defect this epic exists to remove. (from 41r.1)
- [untested-clause] When an architectural fix makes the named mutation unreachable from the ordered entry point, say so in the completion record and repoint the proof; do not report the unit-test kill as if it were the CLI kill. (from 41r.1)
- [untested-clause] A must phrased "any other X" needs a fixture with an X that is not the one the bug report named; one literal key proves the literal. (from 41r.5)
- [stale-spec] A sentence about an output line must be true for every emitter of that line; grep for the literal before writing "each task". (from 41r.2)
- [other] Tests that rewrite PATH or any process-global for a subprocess run belong in async: false modules, as git_test.exs already does. (from 41r.1 critic)

SECOND CHILD CLOSED + ROUTES (orchestrator, 2026-09-04 08:08 EDT). ancora-41r.4 merged: rebase onto d96d42f byte-identical by range-diff, fast-forward d96d42f -> f818d73. Verifier measured the documented value ending tier=env with a verdict line across check, validate, status and review, three mutations both ways against a 72-test baseline plus a value-only variant proving the docs test compares against Index.detect_spec_dir/1, and established by reverting them that the parsing and review spec sentences were forced by the gate (tier=branch errors=2 warnings=1 without them). Selective audit auto-approved; critic PASS. Gate 2 on f818d73: 414 tests, 3 properties, 0 failures; format, unused-deps and spec.check --base 7511407 pass.

Audits returned BOUNCE → implementer on three children, all bounce 1 of 2, all test- or text-side except one gate clause: 41r.2 (two items: lib/ancora.ex:56 must count identified subjects like the gate, under a dated scope grant for that line only; and the "exactly one finding" claim needs errors=1 and the field-name assertion, since deleting the nil clause yields three findings with 408 tests green), 41r.5 (three items: a fixture whose only unknown key is not `requirement`, an assertion on a non-derivable entry field, a whole-file refute of the `requirement:` literal in both docs; the verifier's own remedy was measured and does not kill the mutation), 41r.1 (six items: scope the derive sentence to change-set prefetch naming the BaseView exception, repoint behavior 1's proof to the batch-port test with the CLI unreachability stated, async: false on the PATH-rewriting module, field-level drift assertions, a gate_error clause for the four new refusals which the auditor showed raise with no verdict line on a real fixture, and the stale moduledoc). Retries spawned for all three on the same worktrees, Codex profile team. 41r.3 remains in audit (critic FAIL on the below-tip fold ordering; verifier PASS).

Merge forecasts onto f818d73: 41r.3 and 41r.5 clean; 41r.1 conflicts in ancora.gate.spec.md and 41r.2 in ancora.parsing.spec.md against 41r.4's spec edits, so those two will take implementer rebases after approval. console_triggers=4 console_redeploys=4. Console: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/47c7ca0b-520f-456c-b981-c97a4fe90f1a

LESSON + ROUTE (orchestrator, 2026-09-04 08:14 EDT). ancora-41r.3 audit returned BOUNCE → implementer, bounce 1 of 2. The read-only critic was right and the cold verifier's PASS missed it: deleting only the second Enum.reverse in the below-tip fold leaves the winning severity resolving nearest while the retained below-tip value reverts to oldest-wins, the gate's equality conjunct goes false, and the squash-loss warning is silenced. The auditor built the three-commit fixture and drove it through the real CLI: branch passes with empty stderr, and after a real squash the trunk run flips to result=fail errors=1. That mutation survives the three named files and the full 410-test suite, so the merge gate would not have caught it. Three items: a CLI test with two conflicting below-tip acknowledgments and a bare tip pinning stderr by equality; a test for the severity_source == :trailer clause (dropping it prints a squash-loss warning for a code config cannot tune; a gap under the every-clause rule); two stale doc sentences in the trailer module. The by-value non-tip computation stays unit-tested by design: one call site, one reader, indistinguishable at the gate; the auditor wrote that down so no later grader reopens it. Retry spawned, profile team.

LESSONS
- [untested-clause] When a read-only critic names a specific mutation and the verifier's PASS does not show that mutation was run, the selective gate is not clean; the auditor runs it. A critic FAIL is a mutation order, not an opinion to weigh against a PASS. (from 41r.3)
- [untested-clause] A fold direction is a contract clause; every reverse in a fold needs a fixture whose elements differ in the dimension the fold orders. Two elements that agree prove nothing about order. (from 41r.3)
